description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Leap Mode I (Freya)] to the user, grants [Dragoon Resonance +3% Boost] to all Dragoon allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Leap Mode I (Freya)
description.text: Dragoon abilities deal 30% more damage, Dragoon and Dancer abilities trigger 2 additional times, instant cast speed for Dancer abilities, grants [HP Stock (3000)] to all allies after using two Dragoon or Dancer abilities

description.name: Jump Instant Cast 1
